description: Restart while a retry is in its durable delay window. The retry deadline row must survive and fire exactly once after restart, with no duplicate phase advancement.
expected_observable: After restart the persisted timer row is intact; on/after its deadline recovery fires a single recovered TimerFired command (idempotent by timer id) and the retry proceeds once; a second restart does not re-fire the same timer.

fixture_refs.timer: ledger timers row (timer_id, kind=Retry, fire_at, state)
